purpose: Explicitly map the current restored V4 and frozen clean-sheet learner surfaces back to the preserved V2 course/content identities so presentation work can reuse the deeper corpus without treating either UI as a new knowledge authority.
rules: Course IDs are lineage keys, not a requirement to expose one public card per ID.
A V4 or clean-sheet block may present several V2 identities as one learner-facing bundle.
A V2 identity may contribute to several learner surfaces without being duplicated or rewritten as separate source truth.

Where a current surface teaches a new presentation concept without one exact V2 course container, map it to reusable V2 content/competency families rather than inventing a fake one-to-one course identity.
Specialist/hazardous identities remain bounded by canonical authority and review state regardless of where they are linked.

v4.crosswalk_rule: Use Fundamentals and First Five Calls as the narrative spine; pull bounded Field Skill examples and logistics context as supporting modules without turning every field-skill ID into a required prerequisite.

v4.presentation_role: cross-lane mental model / dependency and troubleshooting literacy
v4.crosswalk_rule: Systems Thinking is a reusable cross-lane presentation bundle, not a replacement for the deeper department-specific V2 sources. Generic mental models may be shared; platform-specific operation stays in the owning lane and authority context.
V4 may present the warehouse/shop lifecycle as one coherent foundation course while retaining the V2 receiving/inventory/QC/traffic/battery/truck-stage/return identities as deeper graph nodes.

Explorer compares lanes and responsibility patterns. It does not make controlled specialties equivalent to ordinary beginner task training and does not impose Stagehand Fundamentals as a universal prerequisite.

v4.presentation_role: deep technical / lead / management discovery and gated future access
v4.crosswalk_rule: Advanced is a presentation/gating surface over retained deep V2 nodes. It does not publish premium lesson bodies by merely listing the lane, and course depth does not create external qualification or appointment.
The Sources UI should project canonical claim/source/review/media/lineage state, not a manually curated bibliography disconnected from support edges.

shared_foundation_overlay.role: reusable communication / direction / clarification / report-back / handoff foundation
shared_foundation_overlay.injection_rule: May appear across Start, Crew Ready, Systems Thinking, departments, Field Skills, and leadership paths without becoming a universal prerequisite container.

controlled_specialty_overlay.rule: Presentation surfaces may teach recognition, system literacy, interfaces, role boundaries, STOP/ASK/escalation, and qualification context. They must not infer operational authorization from learner progression.

implementation_use: When migrating V4 content, attach canonical course/content/competency IDs to each block.
When a V4 block is a synthesis of several V2 identities, preserve all contributing lineage references rather than inventing a new unsupported source claim.
When clean-sheet wording is reused, treat it as presentation prose that must resolve through current matrix claims/evidence before publication.
Use the crosswalk to generate learner-path edges after owner acceptance of PR #57.
Do not delete old V2 identities merely because multiple IDs render inside one successor bundle.
